product.name: Private Office Space
product.description: Furnished, move-in-ready office space for teams of different sizes, available through flexible membership terms.

product.name: Coworking Access
product.description: Shared workspace access through monthly memberships, including access to professional amenities across participating WeWork locations.

product.name: Enterprise Solutions
product.description: Flexible commercial real estate solutions that combine turnkey offices, coworking space, and space-management capabilities for large organizations.

product.name: Workspace for the Day
product.description: Pay-as-you-go access to coworking spaces, offices, and meeting rooms without requiring a recurring membership.

product.name: Meeting Rooms
product.description: Bookable meeting spaces for individual sessions, team meetings, client discussions, and other business gatherings.

product.name: Space Management Technology
product.description: Workplace portfolio technology for booking space, supporting in-person collaboration, and using real-time data to inform real estate decisions.
